development_failures.failure: Bounded executable oracle startup failed under an additional 8 GiB virtual-address-space cap; Lean cache read diagnostic was on stdout and initially hidden by stderr-only reporting.
development_failures.resolution: Preserved original logs and manifest, exposed stdout and stderr in wrapper, and verified direct startup without additional address-space cap. Final production oracle remains a separate required gate.

limits: The mathematical verdict concerns the stated finite source-generative model, not actual-provider stationarity or authentication.
The raw input recorder accepts supplied labels; its lifecycle validation alone does not prove source coupling.
No completion-conditioned coverage, availability guarantee, multi-episode update theorem or physical-spend identity.
Python, registry export, JSON parser and release gates have bounded independent checks and practical code review, not universal formal refinement.
Full-project clean build, exact axiom audit, negative suite, oracle, inherited regressions and package integrity are separate required release gates.
The review uses the same Lean/compiler/kernel trust boundary and is not an alternative-kernel check.
